records.command:
kill -TERM 48605 11024
node --input-type=module - <<'JS'
import{execFileSync}from'node:child_process';import{readFile}from'node:fs/promises';const files=execFileSync('git',['ls-files','--modified','--others','--exclude-standard','-z']).toString().split('\0').filter(Boolean);const pattern=/(?:sk-(?:proj-|or-v1-)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----|Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{24,})/g;let issues=0;for(const path of files){const b=await readFile(path);if(b.includes(0))continue;if(pattern.test(b.toString()))issues++;pattern.lastIndex=0;}if(issues)throw Error('Credential-shaped content in final receipts');console.log({finalReceiptFiles:files.length,credentialFindings:issues,productionHealthy:(await fetch('http://localhost:3211')).ok});
JS
git add -A
git commit -q -m 'Record verified seven-scene delivery receipts'
git push origin main > .local/seven-smart-2026-10-20/push-receipts.log 2>&1
git diff --quiet
git diff --cached --quiet
git log -3 --format='%h %s'
git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main
cat .local/seven-smart-2026-10-20/push-receipts.log
